Third-party scripts, served from the site so the page needs no CDN.

gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js
  GSAP 3.12.5 by GreenSock, from cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/
  Licence: GSAP Standard "no charge" licence, https://gsap.com/standard-license

lenis.min.js
  Lenis 1.1.13 by darkroom.engineering, from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.1.13/dist/
  Licence: MIT, https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/blob/main/LICENSE

Fonts (assets/fonts/)
  outfit-var.woff2: Outfit variable, latin subset, from @fontsource-variable/outfit@5.1.0.
  Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL-Outfit.txt). Stand-in for Mazzard until its
  text weights and a web licence arrive.
  local/: licensed fonts kept out of git (Canela Thin). See experimental-assets/DECISIONS.md.
